text:
alex: Heads-up: kicking a config-only rollout to introduce a ratchet limiter for smallburst tenants and lower default per-tenant concurrency 16->12. Change window 12:20-12:40 PST. Canary first, no model/code changes.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed. CI green. Preparing config v2026.03.ratchet-001 -> canary(5%).

mike: Ack. I set up dashboards (p50/p95/p99, queue depth, kvcache miss). I'll watch the top tail and errors.

sarah: Added a safety fallback: enterprise tenants pinned to route-A if errors > 0.5% during rollout.

deploy-bot: canary deployed @12:22 PST. 5% traffic on ratchet-001. health: ok, no error spikes in first 2m.

jess: Noted a small p99 bump (~+60ms) on canary, low QPS though. Could be batching change side-effect.

mike: KV miss rate looks slightly up. The rollout shortened batching.window from 20ms -> 10ms in this config which can increase tail. Suggest revert batching.window on canary to 15ms and keep limiter.

alex: Prefer minimal change: patch canary with batching.window=15ms, keep the ratchet limiter and concurrency change. Quick patch then revalidate.

deploy-bot: Applying patch v2026.03.ratchet-002 to canary (batching.window=15ms). Rolling 5%.

deploy-bot: canary health: ok. p99 back down ~15ms under baseline. No error upticks.

sarah: OK to staged rollout. Plan: 25% for 10m, then 50% if stable. Keep enterprise fallback pin until 50%.

alex: Agreed. Release notes (short): "Config-only: ratchet limiter to smooth smallburst tenants; default tenant concurrency 16->12; batching.window tuned to 15ms." I'll add full notes to the release doc.

mike: Monitoring heatmap, queue depth, and kvcache. Alert thresholds: p99 > +100ms OR error rate > 0.2% -> call rollback.

deploy-bot: scaling to 25% @12:35 PST. Canary group: 25% global. health: degraded in ap-southeast-1 — latency spike observed.

jess: Confirmed: regional KV spike. It looks like the routing policy matched wrong for some tenants, sending them to fallback routing which caused cold caches and higher latency.

alex: Immediate mitigation: roll back routing policy in ap-southeast-1 to previous selector. Do that now and keep rest of rollout.

deploy-bot: rolled back routing policy in ap-southeast-1. 25% global remains. Region latency recovering.

mike: Latency normalizing in that region. Recommend proceed to 50% but exclude ap-southeast-1 until routing rule is fixed.

sarah: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up config patch to correct the routing tag matching logic (selector missed region_hint). Schedule a dry-run for the fix.

alex: Postmortem note for release doc: selector missed _region_hint_ tag; add one integration test for routing selectors. For now: staged rollout resumes to 50% excluding ap-southeast-1.

deploy-bot: promoted to 50% @12:48 PST excluding ap-southeast-1. Health: stable.

jess: :thumbsup: Filing the routing-fix PR and adding links to the release notes + incident blurb.

alex: Thanks team. After the fix and dry-run we'll unexclude ap-southeast-1. Reminder: this was a config-only deploy, no model changes; keep an eye on long-tail metrics for next 24h.
